chapter: Arrival and the Pete Lala photograph
title: Learning violin and clarinet; Frankie Dusen and Pete Lala's band
summary: Willie E. says he started violin young and clarinet in 1910, and played with Frankie Dusen and in Pete Lala's band.

blocks.x: Yes. I was wondering about your father. Did he start you on a clarinet? Did you learn any other instrument, or did you start on clarinet?
I started on violin at five years old. On violin. Yeah, I used to play at the age of 13.
I used to play at the age of 13 years old. When did you start on clarinet?
I heard you played with the Eagle Band once. I know.
Yeah, I played with Frankie Dusen. I played with Frankie Dusen.
Was that your first band that you played in?
I played violin at that five years old.
I started violin at 13 years old. I played with Mr. What's it called?
Who is Mr. What's it called?
